user_prompt:
method correct_bracketing(brackets: seq<char>) returns (result: bool)
    requires brackets != null
    ensures result == (count_opening_brackets(brackets) == count_closing_brackets(brackets) && is_well_formed(brackets))

method count_opening_brackets(brackets: seq<char>) returns (count: int)
    requires brackets != null
    ensures count >= 0

method count_closing_brackets(brackets: seq<char>) returns (count: int)
    requires brackets != null
    ensures count >= 0

method is_well_formed(brackets: seq<char>) returns (well_formed: bool)
    requires brackets != null
    ensures well_formed == (forall i :: 0 <= i < |brackets| ==> (count_opening_brackets(subseq(brackets, 0, i)) >= count_closing_brackets(subseq(brackets, 0, i))))
